subject: 164/165 feedback_correct fields start lowercase — voice guide compliance
body: GP test gp-feedback-correct-starts-with-capital found that 164/165 feedback_correct fields start with a lowercase letter. The voice guide specifies coach-style, direct communication. While this is informational (not blocking), lowercase sentence starts may feel informal. GD: please flag whether the voice guide requires capitalization for feedback strings. If yes, GR should update all feedback_correct and feedback_wrong fields. GP will not modify content — this is GR/GD scope.
